beaches.name: Molyvos (Delfinia)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is usual at the far southern end of the town beach, past the hotel parasols. A naturist directory carries consistent visitor reports from 2005 to May 2024; the 2024 report counts 95 percent of visitors naked. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Eftalou (Tsichranta bays)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is usual in the pebble bays beyond the first, past the thermal baths. A naturist directory carries consistent visitor reports from 2005 to June 2022, with a 2022 report of naturists in all bays but the first. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Skala Eresou (west end)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is the norm around and beyond a dry riverbed about 1 km west of town. A naturist directory carries consistent reports from 2003 to August 2022; the 2022 report found almost everyone nude despite one taverna's 'nudism not allowed' sign, which beachgoers ignore.
